answers.questionRaw: PART 2 — PASSAGE COMPLETIONQuestions 13–17Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the option that best fits each numbered blank from 13 to 17. THE NEW HARVEST FESTIVAL For many generations, the people of Minh Son held a festival after completing the main rice harvest. In the past, nearly every family worked in the surrounding fields. (13) ______. The festival gave them an opportunity to rest, share food, and express gratitude for a successful harvest. The event traditionally began early in the morning. Older residents prepared ceremonial dishes, while young adults arranged tables in the communal-house yard. Children carried fruit and flowers to the main hall. (14) ______. After the ceremony, families ate together and joined traditional games. Over time, fewer residents worked directly in farming. Many young adults found jobs in the nearby town, and some families could return to Minh Son only at weekends. The original weekday festival date therefore became difficult for many people. (15) ______. Instead, residents discussed how the timetable could change while the festival’s main purpose remained. They eventually decided to hold the public celebration on the nearest Sunday after the harvest ceremony. The smaller ceremony still takes place on its traditional date and is attended mainly by residents who live nearby. (16) ______. This arrangement allows more family members to participate without removing the original ceremony. Some details have also changed. Food is now prepared in several homes instead of entirely in the communal-house yard, and the games begin later in the afternoon. However, the main dishes, expressions of gratitude, and shared meal remain. (17) ______.Question 13A. Neighbours often helped one another bring in the rice before the seasonal rains arrived.B. Several families travelled to the nearby town to buy rice from large shops.C. The communal house was closed because nobody wanted to organise the harvest.D. Children attended school throughout the festival and did not join their families.Write A, B, C, or D – {#1}Question 14A. Some villagers wanted to replace the ceremony with a sports competition.B. Visitors left the village before the traditional food was prepared.C. A short ceremony then thanked earlier generations and celebrated the harvest.D. The families sold their fruit and flowers at the town market.Write A, B, C, or D – {#2}Question 15A. The village immediately cancelled the festival and removed all its traditions.B. However, people did not want family absence to bring the celebration to an end.C. Younger residents asked to replace the harvest festival with a music event.D. The communal house was turned into an office during the harvest season.Write A, B, C, or D – {#3}Question 16A. The village has stopped preparing the traditional meal for visiting families.B. Farmers now conduct the public celebration before bringing in the rice.C. The Sunday event includes the shared meal, games, and larger family gathering.D. Only children and visitors are allowed to attend the traditional ceremony.Write A, B, C, or D – {#4}Question 17A. The festival has adapted to present circumstances while preserving its central meaning.B. The changes have made the festival completely different from its earlier form.C. Most families now attend mainly because they want to buy agricultural products.D. The village plans to replace the communal ceremony with a modern food market.Write A, B, C, or D – {#5}
